title: Weinstein attends Ed Witten's first string theory lecture
summary: Eric Weinstein tells of Weinstein attends Ed Witten's first string theory lecture, about 1983 at University of Pennsylvania, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I happened by complete accident to be at the first lecture of Ed Whitten on string theory at the University of Pennsylvania in 1983

plain: Eric Weinstein, a mathematician and commentator, says that in 1983, purely by accident, he was at the University of Pennsylvania for the first lecture by the leading physicist Ed Witten on string theory, the idea that nature's smallest pieces are tiny vibrating strings. He tells it as being present at the start of a movement that came to dominate physics.
